title: AWKUM Invites Applications for Visiting Faculty – Fall Semester 2025
text:
Visiting Faculty Required - AWKUM

Visiting Faculty Required

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
requires visiting faculty for the
Fall Semester 2025
. Interested and eligible applicants are advised to appear for an interview in the concerned department as per the eligibility criteria and schedule below:

Interview Schedule & Eligibility

S. No | Discipline | No. of Position | Campus of Interview | Interview Schedule | Eligibility Criteria
1 | Human Resource & Information Management | 01 | Office of the Dean Faculty of Business & Economics (B&E), Garden Campus | Thursday, 23rd Sep 2025 09:00 AM – 03:00 PM | MPhil/MS (18 years of education) in the relevant field from an HEC recognized University/Institution with no 3rd division in the academic career.

General Instructions

Eligible applicants must appear for the interview as per the given schedule with CNIC, recent passport-size photograph, and attested copies of educational & experience certificates (if any).

A CGPA of less than 3.00 out of 4.00 shall be considered equivalent to a second division.

Remuneration will be paid on the basis of credit hours assigned and in accordance with the rates approved by the Syndicate.

Applicants must meet the minimum eligibility criteria mentioned above.

Applicants with foreign degrees must provide an HEC Equivalence Certificate at the time of interview.

In-service candidates shall apply through proper channel and submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their parent organization/institution along with the application form.

No TA/DA shall be admissible for appearing in the interview.

Note:
Errors or omissions, if any, are liable to rectification by the University.
